description: Build a clear, repeatable recipe library for LMCache that demonstrates 'Do X and Y, then get Z' with measurable outcomes (TTFT, hit rate, throughput). Recipes cover north-bound engines (vLLM/SGLang/platforms) and south-bound backends/modes (CPU/disk/GDS/remote/P2P/PD), plus optimizations.

Template for all subsequent recipes.
